headline: 紀錄片與音樂劇評論
context: 英國喜劇演員 Rik Mayall 的紀錄片《Magnificent B'Stard》讓老搭檔 Ade Edmondson 的悲傷躍然眼前；改編自 2014 年電影的音樂劇《Pride》，重現 1980 年代同志運動者為威爾斯礦村募款的真實情誼。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Packed with fun memories from Ben Elton and Stephen Fry plus heartbreaking regret from his former partner, the Bottom star is so adored that this documentary risks descending into cringe – but his punky spirit shines through Rik Mayall: Magnificent B’Stard is a homage to the man and an elegy for what you have to presume were the lost youths of most of the viewing audience. I don’t know what the current youth would make of it. I suppose they’re not watching television anyway, so the question’s moot. Plus, of course, it doesn’t matter. This is 90 minutes of television for us – the generation that grew up with Mayall on screen as Rick the Poet (“This is my angriest poem – Theatre!”), then self-styled investigative reporter from and mostly in Redditch, Kevin Turvey, then in The Young Ones as anarchist sociology student Rick and on through its less wildly popular follow-up Filthy Rich & Catflap. Then there was his unforgettable turn as Lord Flashheart in Blackadder II (and as the horndog lord’s equally priapic descendant Squadron Commander Flashheart in Blackadder Goes Forth); the unexpected pivot towards a more restrained demonstration of his comic talents as oleaginous, ruthless, corrupt, entirely fictional Tory MP Alan B’Stard in Marks and Gran’s brilliant The New Statesman; a Hollywood punt as Drop Dead Fred; then the huge success of Bottom as a sitcom and a live show throughout the 90s until a terrible quad biking accident in 1998 trimmed his sails. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Dorfman theatre, London The director and writer of the hit 2014 film deliver a stage celebration of togetherness in the face of adversity A group of 1980s LGBTQ+ activists begin fundraising for a south Wales pit village in the dark days of the miners’ strikes. It leads to an enduring friendship between the communities and a massive ripple effect beyond. This nugget of intersectional queer/mining history might sound like the unlikely trajectory of a feelgood Richard Curtis film – but it really happened. There is, in fact, already a film. Pride, from 2014 , was made with a bucket-load of national treasures including Imelda Staunton and Bill Nighy, created in the same “against-the-odds” mould as Billy Elliot and The Full Monty. This magnificent new musical reunites the screenwriter Stephen Beresford (book and lyrics) with director Matthew Warchus, who has developed the show as well as staged it. Continue reading...
sources.title: Pride review – solidarity between gay activists and miners in a magnificent musical

thread_text:
兩篇評論。Rik Mayall 紀錄片《Magnificent B'Stard》集合 Ben Elton、Stephen Fry 的回憶與老搭檔 Ade Edmondson 至今未散的悲傷，評論說它幾乎溺於仰慕，但 Mayall 的龐克精神仍然發光。音樂劇《Pride》改編自 2014 年同名電影：1980 年代的同志運動者為威爾斯礦村募款，一段真實情誼被搬上舞台，獲評「壯麗」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 6 月 26 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
兩篇評論，都跟記憶有關。英國喜劇演員 Rik Mayall 的紀錄片《Magnificent B'Stard》，集合了 Ben Elton、Stephen Fry 的有趣回憶，還有老搭檔 Ade Edmondson 至今未散的悲傷。評論說，這部片被愛意淹得差點膩——但 Mayall 的龐克精神還是穿透出來。另一邊，音樂劇《Pride》改編自 2014 年的同名電影：1980 年代英國礦工大罷工的黑暗日子裡，一群同志運動者為威爾斯礦村募款，兩個社群結下持久的友誼。舞台版被評為「壯麗」，是一場逆境裡的團結慶典。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 6 月 26 日發佈的報導。
